name: Victoria Vega
source:
The number one delinquent of the school. She's irritable and often picks fights with others such as Rita or [url=https://vndb.org/c174076]Yui[/url]. She's best friends with her fellow delinquent [url=https://vndb.org/c174105]Vanessa[/url], and has a complicated relationship with [url=https://vndb.org/c174173]Ms. Clark[/url]. This is compounded further by her difficulty coming to terms with her own bisexuality.
